import ctypes

seed=sum((libc.rand()&0xff)<<(8*i) for i in range(4))
print(hex(seed))
s=seed
def get32():
 global s
 tmp=33614*s; q=(tmp&0xffffffff)>>1; p=tmp>>32; mlcg=p+q
 if mlcg & 0x80000000: mlcg=(mlcg&0x7fffffff)+1
 s=mlcg; return s
print('coap msgid low', hex(get32()&0xffff))
raw=[get32()&0xff for _ in range(8)]
ext=raw.copy(); ext[0]=(ext[0]&~1)|2
iid=ext.copy(); iid[0]^=2
print('raw', bytes(raw).hex(), 'ext', bytes(ext).hex(), 'iid', bytes(iid).hex())
print('ll', bytes([0xfe,0x80]+[0]*6+iid).hex())
